projectStates.loadingDescription: Checking access and loading saved project data.

projectStates.permissionDescription: You do not currently have access to this project, or it no longer exists. No data was modified.
projectStates.projectErrorUnknown: The project request failed without an error message.
projectStates.projectErrorDescription: Existing data was not modified. Reload the project data.
projectStates.missingTitle: The project response has no data
projectStates.missingDescription: No displayable project content was returned. Kuiper did not substitute empty data.
projectStates.projectIssueUnknown: Project details could not be refreshed.
projectStates.episodeIssueUnknown: Episode progress: failed to load without an error message.

projectHome.description: Review the story source, production progress, and the next actionable step.
projectHome.loadingDescription: Project details are ready. The statistics below will update when available.
projectHome.partialDescription: Loaded project data remains usable. Missing values are not inferred as zero.

overview.mapDescription: This compact list shows stage status. Use the read-only production lineage above for the full relationship view. Unwired progress is labeled clearly.
overview.stageVoice: The home API does not provide a voice summary yet
overview.settingsDescription: Expand the existing ratio, duration, model, and style settings.
overview.settingsReadOnlyDescription: Nothing was changed. Ask the project owner for edit access.
overview.nextDescription: Based on saved completion data. Opening this stage only views or edits data; it does not create a generation job or cost.
overview.nextUndeterminedTitle: The next step cannot be determined reliably
overview.nextUndeterminedDescription: The first unresolved stage has no reliable status, so no speculative shortcut is shown. You can still inspect every stage in the workflow below.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.loadingDescription: Saved project, style, and model choices are being loaded. No fallback values can be selected yet.
projectSettings.sourceError: This source could not be loaded.
projectSettings.sourceUnavailable: This source returned no usable data.
projectSettings.backgroundIssueTitle: Some settings could not be refreshed
projectSettings.backgroundIssueDescription: The last successfully loaded values remain available below.
projectSettings.saveFailed: Save failed. The previous setting was restored.
projectSettings.unknownError: The service did not provide an error message.
projectSettings.durationHint: Affects storyboard count. Re-analyze or regroup after changing it.
projectSettings.resolutionUnsupported: The current Fast model does not support 1080p.
projectSettings.analysisHint: Used for screenplay breakdown and character, location, and prop extraction.
projectSettings.noTextModels: No text model is enabled. Enable one in your profile before selecting it here.
projectSettings.currentModelUnavailable: currently selected · not in enabled list
projectSettings.visualLibraryDescription: A visual style adds a saved text-level style anchor to the existing image direction. Leaving it unselected preserves the current behavior.

storyBible.readOnlyDescription: You can review all saved content. Editing stories or production settings requires project edit access. Full canon fields are not connected.
storyBible.excerptNotice: Project Home shows an excerpt. The full source remains in Screenplay.
storyBible.sourceErrorTitle: The story source is temporarily unavailable
storyBible.sourceEmptyTitle: No story source has been imported
storyBible.sourceErrorDescription: Project details remain available. Reload episode data to restore the story source.
storyBible.sourceEmptyDescription: Add a story, screenplay, or episode in Screenplay before Story Basis has a reliable source.
storyBible.summaryEmpty: This project has no summary. Kuiper will not infer one.
storyBible.architectureDescription: Only saved episode names, summaries, and story-source status are shown.
storyBible.episodesErrorDescription: The project summary and asset statistics remain available. Reload to restore episode data.
storyBible.episodesEmptyDescription: Import the first episode in Screenplay to build this structure.
storyBible.graphDescription: Story Basis currently organizes the saved project summary, source story, episodes, and asset coverage. There is no save action here.
storyBible.graphDetails: Full canon fields—Premise, Theme, Tone, World Rules, Canon Lock, and version history—are not connected yet.

shotBuilder.title: Shot Builder
shotBuilder.description: Select a storyboard shot, verify upstream characters and locations, then review its prompt, references, and output settings.
shotBuilder.aiPlanNotice: AI Plan is not connected to planning data or a save API yet. This view only shows saved Storyboard shots.
shotBuilder.loadErrorBlocking: The current shots and project settings cannot be determined safely, so no empty or unset data was substituted.
shotBuilder.loadErrorStale: Refresh failed. The last successfully loaded shots and project settings remain below.
shotBuilder.projectErrorUnknown: Project settings: request failed without an error message.
shotBuilder.storyboardErrorUnknown: Storyboard data: request failed without an error message.
shotBuilder.emptyDescription: Create shots from the screenplay in Storyboard. Saved shots, keyframes, and references will appear here.
shotBuilder.promptMissing: This shot has no motion prompt. Complete it in Storyboard before generating.
shotBuilder.generationBoundary: This view uses real shot and version data. Cost confirmation and submission remain in the existing Storyboard flow to avoid a second billing entry point.
shotBuilder.generateInStoryboard: Confirm cost and generate in Storyboard

clipComposer.title: Clip Composer
clipComposer.description: Review generated shots, assemble a main cut, and check ratio, audio, and timeline coverage before delivery.
clipComposer.boundary: Real shot media, preview, and timeline selection are available. Split, trim, captions, effects, and multitrack saves will be enabled with the Timeline API; nothing is written or overwritten yet.
clipComposer.loadErrorBlocking: The current media and project settings cannot be determined safely, so no empty timeline or unset data was substituted.
clipComposer.loadErrorStale: Refresh failed. The last successfully loaded media and project settings remain below.
clipComposer.projectErrorUnknown: Project settings: request failed without an error message.
clipComposer.storyboardErrorUnknown: Storyboard data: request failed without an error message.
clipComposer.emptyDescription: Complete at least one storyboard image or video to add it to the media library and main-cut timeline.
clipComposer.unavailableTool: This tool has a defined UI, but its data contract is not connected and it will not write to the timeline.
clipComposer.readOnly: This is a read-only preview. Adjustments and version writes will be enabled after the Timeline save API is connected.
clipComposer.timelineBoundary: Timeline versions, Undo/Redo, and multitrack saves are not connected. Current actions do not modify source media.
